candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Data Science Internship at Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg. Turning manufacturing data into clear dashboards that help people decide what to fix is what I did for a manufacturer in my previous role, and I would love to do it at the scale of a Gigafactory.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I worked in SAP data and analytics at TallyMarks Consulting and as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea.

achievements.impact: I rebuilt a manufacturer's dashboard end to end covering OEE, machine efficiency, downtime and yield
I built SAP Analytics Cloud dashboards on ABAP CDS view data models, including one that replaced a manual per-material check across thousands of materials, and validated data with SQL
I built DocuMind (github.com/Rayyan3079/documind-rag), a Python LLM application with a Streamlit dashboard, 37 unit tests, CI and a README written for other users

letter.problems_section: I would refine problem statements with engineers, query and analyse production data in Python and SQL, build dashboards and document everything clearly. I have not used Dash or Plotly in a project yet, but I build dashboards quickly, most recently in Streamlit.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to the Berlin area and can start immediately. As a non-EU student I will agree the internship length and hours with you so they fit my permitted working days. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
